text: Biology is a fundamental discipline that studies life phenomena and their laws, covering multiple levels from molecules and cells to individuals, populations, and ecosystems. It involves core issues such as the origin, evolution, development, metabolism, and genetics of life. As a highly interdisciplinary subject, biology is deeply integrated with chemistry, physics, mathematics and computer science, giving rise to cutting-edge directions such as molecular biology, bioinformatics and synthetic biology. This major aims to cultivate talents with solid theoretical foundations, experimental operation skills and scientific research thinking. It emphasizes systematic understanding from micro mechanisms to macro ecology. Common branches include cell biology, genetics, ecology, biotechnology, biomedicine, etc.
